mapper.insert: INSERT INTO underpass_transit (underpass_id, car_num, entry_plate_log_id, status, entry_at) VALUES (#{underpassId}, #{carNum}, #{entryPlateLogId}, #{status}, #{entryAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, underpass_id, car_num, entry_plate_log_id, exit_plate_log_id, status, entry_at, exit_at FROM underpass_transit WHERE underpass_id = #{underpassId} AND car_num = #{carNum} AND status IN ('IN_TRANSIT', 'REMAINING') ORDER BY entry_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE underpass_transit SET status = 'REMAINING' WHERE underpass_id = #{underpassId} AND status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.underpass_id, u.name AS underpass_name, t.car_num, t.status, t.entry_at, t.exit_at FROM underpass_transit t JOIN underpass u ON u.id = t.underpass_id
ORDER BY t.entry_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM underpass_transit t JOIN underpass u ON u.id = t.underpass_id
SELECT DISTINCT car_num FROM underpass_transit WHERE underpass_id = #{underpassId} AND status IN ('IN_TRANSIT', 'REMAINING')
mapper.update: UPDATE underpass_transit SET status = 'EXITED', exit_at = NOW() WHERE status IN ('IN_TRANSIT', 'REMAINING') AND entry_at <= NOW() - make_interval(mins => #{minutes})
